sec_288.officialSourceTitle: Office of the Council of State — Thai
sec_288.statutoryText: Whoever kills another person shall be punished with death, imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of fifteen to twenty years.
sec_288.educationalExplanation: Requires specific intent to kill (desire or foresight of fatal result).

sec_290.officialSourceTitle: Office of the Council of State — Thai
sec_290.statutoryText: Whoever causes death to another person by inflicting injury upon life/body without intent to kill shall be punished with imprisonment of three to fifteen years.
sec_290.educationalExplanation: Applies when intent was limited to bodily injury or assault, but death resulted as a consequence.
sec_290.verificationStatus: Verified against official primary source — Unofficial English translation
sec_290.revisionHistory: v1.2 — Aligned with official Gazette text

sec_335.officialSourceTitle: Office of the Council of State — Thai
sec_335.statutoryText: Whoever commits theft at night or by damaging or bypassing barriers intended for protection shall be punished with imprisonment of one to five years.
sec_335.educationalExplanation: Aggravated theft provisions elevating penalties due to nighttime timing or security barrier circumvention.
sec_335.verificationStatus: Verified against official primary source — Unofficial English translation
sec_335.revisionHistory: v1.2 — Aligned with official Gazette text

sec_78.officialSourceTitle: Office of the Council of State — Thai
sec_78.statutoryText: Any driver involved in an accident causing damage to persons or property shall stop, render assistance, and report to police immediately. Failure to stop creates a statutory presumption of fault.
sec_78.educationalExplanation: Hit-and-run provisions establishing a legal presumption of fault against drivers who flee without rendering assistance.
